fy26.src: ar26 cons. P&L (PDF p.226), note 26-27, AGM notice (final dividend Rs2.50); q4ppt pp.4-6; corpdeck pp.5-8; q4call p.5, p.9

commentary: Revenue Rs329.7 cr, +59.1%: Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediates Rs292.7 cr (+76.5%) on CDMO and 'top products as well as a couple of new products'; Specialty Chemicals Rs37.0 cr (-10.6%) as commodity chemicals are phased out while Baba Fine Chemicals (BFC) recovered (Abhishek Patel, 24-Jul-2026).
Gross margin 57.9% (+466bp YoY, -410bp QoQ); EBITDA Rs113.1 cr, margin 34.3% (+973bp YoY). Segment EBITDA margins: pharma ~36%, specialty ~24% (CFO).
Other income fell to Rs1.8 cr from Rs15.9 cr a year ago: Q4FY26 had ~Rs10 cr of euro forex gains, Q1FY27 only Rs0.1 cr (CFO).

Battery chemicals: trial run of the Jhagadia plant done and commercial supply started; demand 'unprecedented'; multiple customers (North America, Korea); full use of 2,000 MT VC + 2,000 MT FEC in three years; third additive (Phase 2) capex done by end-Q2FY27 with a signed contract; a fourth in final contract stage.
Indichem (Korea): construction ahead of schedule, capex done by end-Q2FY27, revenue from FY28, full capacity in 3-4 years; margins to be benchmarked to BFC, not to pharma.
A 10% stake in the electrolyte subsidiary was given to business partner ARZ (as agreed earlier) for developing and selling the additives.
Guidance reaffirmed: ~25% revenue growth in FY27 with EBITDA margin similar to FY26 (~36%); employee cost ~Rs150 cr in FY27 (Q1 includes one-time bonuses).
CDMO: Rs1,000 cr CDMO revenue target 'confident to beat'; four validated CDMO products to start contributing from H2FY27, Rs50-100 cr each at peak; 30-40 new molecules developed a year.

Capacity use Q1FY27: Sachin 83% (at the roof), Ankleshwar 23% (fills by ~FY28), Jhagadia 55%; land being sought for the next pharma plant; a new R&D centre (10x) is planned; both capex amounts not yet announced.
Net cash ~Rs314 cr at 30-Jun-2026; working capital 99 days vs 91 days in Q4FY26. No plan to move into APIs ('we do not compete with our customers').

history: Q4FY25 call (May-2025): CDMO to reach Rs1,000 cr by FY28; long-run ~25% revenue growth.
Q4FY26 call (30-Apr-2026): FY26 revenue Rs1,339 cr (+33%) and EBITDA margin 35.9% vs 23.0%; guides FY27 +25% at similar margins ('Q4 is too ambitious').
Q1FY27 call (24-Jul-2026): Q1 revenue +59%; 25% growth and similar margins reaffirmed; battery supplies started; Indichem capex done by end-Q2FY27.

cdmo.anchor: 10-year supply agreement signed in CY22 with Fermion Oy (Orion Corporation's API arm) for five key intermediates of darolutamide (Nubeqa); Orion makes the tablets, Bayer markets globally. 'Majority' of CDMO revenue (PL).
cdmo.nubeqa: Bayer raised Nubeqa peak-sales guidance from >EUR1bn to >EUR3bn and expected ~50% growth in 2026 (PL, citing Bayer/Orion). Patent expiry (PL Exhibit 24): USA 2033, Japan 2033, Brazil 2033, Germany/France/Italy/Spain/Switzerland 2035, UK 2029.
cdmo.pipeline: Four more CDMO products validated in FY26; regulatory approval awaited; revenue from H2FY27, Rs50-100 cr each at peak (q4call, q1call).
